title: 2009 HMMT February Combinatorics Problem 5
statement:
Let \(s(n)\) denote the number of 1's in the binary representation of \(n\). Compute

\[\frac{1}{255} \sum_{0 \leq n<16} 2^{n}(-1)^{s(n)}\]

solutions.text: Notice that if \(n<8,(-1)^{s(n)}=(-1) \cdot(-1)^{s(n+8)}\) so the sum becomes \(\frac{1}{255}\left(1-2^{8}\right) \sum_{0 \leq n<8} 2^{n}(-1)^{s(n)}=\) 45.
